title: Playboy Magazine June 1986 Kathy Shower Playmate of the Year Linda Evans Kareem
conditionDescription: Cover clean with light edge and handling wear. Centerfold not separately verified.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, June 1986 issue. Cover price $3.50.

Features:
- Playmate of the Year Kathy Shower - cover and pictorial
- Dynasty star Linda Evans nude
- Kareem Abdul-Jabbar interviewed
- The Secrets of Easily Orgasmic Women
- Robin Leach Explained
- What We Really Know About AIDS

The back cover carries a 1986 DeBeers diamond ad.

Condition: pre-owned with normal signs of age and storage. Cover clean with light edge and handling wear. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
